title: New Contact Support Experience in Outlook for iOS, Android and Mac
summary: A new Contact Support experience is rolling out in Outlook for iOS, Android, and Mac, aligning with the new Outlook for Windows. It uses the existing policy "Allow access to Contact Support in the new Outlook." Rollout starts late November 2026, completing by January 2027. No new policy needed; admins with disabled policies must redeploy.
body:
[What and Why:]

We're introducing a new Contact Support experience in Outlook for iOS, Outlook for Android, and Outlook for Mac. This update brings a more consistent way to get help from within the app, aligned with the Contact Support experience available in new Outlook for Windows.

The existing Contact Support policy for new Outlook, "Allow access to Contact Support in the new Outlook" (outlooknew;L_ContactSupport), will also control Contact Support in Outlook for iOS, Outlook for Android, and Outlook for Mac. No new policy is required.

[Rollout Schedule:]

General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in late November 2026 and expect to complete by early January 2027.

[Impact on Your Organization:]

The existing Contact Support experience has been replaced with a newer one that improves how users discover solutions for resolving issues on their own. The chat experience provided through Contact Support has not changed, so users can still reach a support agent as they do today. In addition, the Contact Support experience in Outlook for iOS, Outlook for Android and Outlook for Mac now adheres to the same cloud service policy used for New Outlook for Windows.

[Action Required/Recommendations:]

Contact Support remains available by default when the policy is enabled or not configured, and administrators who disable the policy will remove access to Contact Support in all of these Outlook clients.

IT admins who have already set the existing policy to "Disabled" will need to redeploy their policy once the updated policy becomes available in the Office Cloud Policy Service (OCPS). Redeploying allows the policy to be updated to include the iOS, Android, and Mac endpoints. If the cloud policy is not redeployed, the Contact Support policy will continue to apply only to new Outlook.

No action is required for organizations that have not configured the policy or have it enabled.

[Compliance considerations:]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
